cli.intro: open-sfx — procedural sound-effect library and CLI
cli.cmd.render: Render one preset to a WAV (positional: <preset> <out.wav>)
cli.cmd.pack: Render the whole preset catalogue into a directory and write manifest.json with sizes and fingerprints (positional: <dir>)
cli.cmd.instrument: Render one instrument preset to a WAV (positional: <preset> <out.wav>)
cli.cmd.pattern: Render one drum groove to a WAV (positional: <preset> <out.wav>)
cli.cmd.verify: Render one preset to a temporary WAV and check container, rate, audibility and reproducibility (positional: <preset>, optional --kind)
cli.opt.kind: Asset kind to verify: sfx (default), instrument or pattern
cli.opt.spec: Read a JSON spec file instead of a preset name
